claim.statement: Mixed-corpus 60-cycle Kimera run (text + CIFAR-10 image + ESC-50 audio) produces ≥10% emit-stream contribution from channel=image AND ≥10% from channel=field (Phonotype), with zero substrate crashes.
claim.operationalization: 60-cycle Takwin instance; cycle plan = 20 text + 20 image + 20 audio shuffled with deterministic seed. Image inputs from CIFAR-10 test (32×32×3, .std() ≥ 5 to avoid near-uniform rejection). Audio inputs from ESC-50 (1-sec mono float32, normalized [-1,1]). All Arachne emits captured via add_observer hook. Per-channel emit count / total emits.
claim.h0: At least one of (image_pct < 0.10, field_pct < 0.10, crashes > 0)

preregistration.analysis_plan: Pre-registered per ROADMAP_2026_05_18.md Phase 2. Mixed-corpus 60-cycle run with text + CIFAR-10 + ESC-50 interleaved. Per-channel emit count threshold ≥10% each. Refuted at threshold; substantive finding (channels wired but text-dominant) documented in PillarEvidence.

detail.interpretation: Image channel IS functionally wired — 100 emits across 20 image cycles (5 per image cycle). Below threshold because text channel dominates emit stream (94.9%) from companion prompts + internal-event emissions.
Field/audio channel (Cochlear Phonotype) IS functionally wired — 118 emits across 20 audio cycles (~6 per audio cycle). Below threshold for same reason as image: text dominance.
Substrate processed all 60 multi-modal cycles without crashes — multi-modal pipeline is structurally stable.

Critical re-framing: the multi-modal channels are NOT 'dormant by code-gap' as the roadmap's REFUTED branch suggested. They are functionally wired and emit consistently when fed real inputs. The ≥10% threshold per channel was overstrict — achieving 10% per modality on a 60-cycle run requires deeply restructuring the substrate's emission distribution (which currently emits ~67 text canonicals per cycle from internal events alone). The architectural state is 'modality channels are active and discriminative; text dominates absolute emit volume by design'.

verdict.reasoning: Threshold strictly REFUTED: image_pct=0.023 < 0.10 AND field_pct=0.027 < 0.10. BUT: 0 crashes, 100 image-channel emits + 118 field-channel emits across 40 multi-modal cycles = multi-modal channels functionally active. Threshold was overstrict vs substrate's natural emission distribution (text dominates 95%).
